answer: Duplicate identities collide on the same opal, so a sybil must acquire and lock a distinct token per fake agent, paying rising stake plus slashing risk. Each agent must stake a unique opal token bound to a hardware-rooted key, and that key anchors a thread of signed attestations across epochs. Honest agents find a haven in this ledger, since forging a parallel thread means re-staking from scratch and forfeiting history. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
